text.zh: 让 AI 操作真 iPhone

shots.purpose: Open on the product doing something
shots.action: The agent sends one type call and the real phone fills a note with 278 characters

narration.zh: 让 AI 直接操作你的真 iPhone，任何 App 都行。
narration.en: Let AI drive your real iPhone. Any app, no API needed.

shots.purpose: Show the screen read as text
shots.action: phone_elements returns the real element rows of the General screen beside its recording

narration.zh: 它把屏幕读成文字，一次大约零点一秒。
narration.en: It reads the screen as text, in about a tenth of a second.

shots.action: The agent asks for Date & Time by name; the recording scrolls and opens that row

narration.zh: 然后按名字点，滑动也一样。
narration.en: Then it taps by name, and scrolls.

shots.action: Two real refusals print in the terminal while the recorded Date & Time page stays exactly as it was

narration.zh: 点不到或没等到，它都直说，还告诉你能不能重试。
narration.en: When a step does not land, it says so, and whether to retry. Nothing is faked.

shots.action: phone_flow_run replays a saved flow and the recording opens Settings in one call

narration.zh: 做过的任务存成流程，重放一次调用，不花 token。
narration.en: Saved flows replay in one call, with no tokens.

shots.action: phone_status prints the Wi-Fi tunnel transport of this very session

narration.zh: 插一次线，之后走加密 Wi-Fi，iOS 15 也行。
narration.en: Plug in once, then go wireless. iOS 15 and up.

shots.holdReason: a real browser recording plays through, then the sidebar controls for the iPhone app and several phones are pointed out
shots.action: In the browser control page a click on the live picture opens Date & Time on the phone; then the sidebar's scan-to-connect and grid controls are pointed out

narration.zh: 还能远程控制：在浏览器里直接点手机画面，外网也能连；用 iPhone App 扫码连上，还能一起控制多台手机。
narration.en: Remote control, too: click the live picture in a browser, even from outside your network, or pair the iPhone app and drive several phones.

shots.action: The icon pops, the name is written and the install command types itself
